name: H-FABP Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of H-FABP using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of Heart-type Fatty Acid Binding Protein (H-FABP) in human serum, plasma or whole blood samples. This test is used in the early diagnosis of AMI and pulmonary embolism, and monitoring of chronic heart failure.
